items.name: Glintstone Pebble
items.japanese_name: 輝石のつぶて (Kiseki no Tsubute)
items.effect: Fires magic projectiles from glintstone
items.summary: Glintstone Pebble is a spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Glintstone Sorceries.
items.description:
The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion.

This is a universal first step on the journey to true knowledge of sorcery.
effect_details: The caster fires a glintstone projectile with Magic Attack Power equal to 152% of Sorcery Scaling at their foe.
Glintstone Pebble can be cast repeatedly.

details: One of the starting spells of the Astrologer Origin.

acquisition.location: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Scadu Altus
details: x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.
x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at Church of Irith.
x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

Should any of these tutors die before purchasing this Sorcery from them, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective Bell Bearing.

notes: Costs 7 FP per cast.
Costs 20 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.
Deals 3 Stance damage.
Glintstone Pebble can be cast repeatedly.
→ It can also be chained with Great Glintstone Shard.
Glintstone Pebble can be cast while walking.
Glintstone Pebble has slight tracking.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased attack power.
patch_notes.community_notes: Curiously, data seems to indicate that the Attack Power (152% of Sorcery Scaling) wasn't changed by the update.

text: Glintstone Pebble is a decent starting sorcery due to its low FP and Intelligence cost, decent range and Attack Power at earlier parts of the game.
As there are many enemies that will input-read and respond to projectiles like the Pebble, it is best not to wantonly cast it at stronger enemies.
From long range, this can be used to lure enemies out and whittle a group down one by one.

text: Generally this is considered to be a poor performing spell in PvE. Uncharged, it's less efficient than a single cast of Glintstone Pebble, and even though it deals more damage when charged, casting other spells in will generally outdamage it while offering greatly more utility than Crystal Barrage.

→ The one notable exception would be in Invasion situations, both players and NPC Bloody Fingers. Such highly evasive opponents would find it rather difficult to evade the entire barrage of a fully charged shot.
Despite poor performance when compared with other spells, its early availability may serve as an introduction to spells that can be truly channeled, such as Crystal Torrent and Comet Azur.

text: Cannon of Haima is useful for clearing out large groups of enemies due to its explosive properties.

The explosion can hit enemies through walls and ceilings, ideal for situations where an enemy is either unreachable or if a preemptive strike is required to soften up targets before approaching, or to ambush targets coming around corners.
Upon hitting normal-sized enemies, it knocks them down, potentially useful in both PvE and PvP, where the blast can knock targets off of cliffs for an instant kill.

After traveling for a certain period of time, the bubble will come to a halt, floating in place. As such, the caster can use this opportunity to lure enemies into the bubble, or forcibly pull enemies into it via Gravity Sorcery.
With the Arrow's Reach Talisman or the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman, the bubble travels farther, allowing the caster to strike an unaware enemy from a further distance away.
Interestingly enough, while casting Great Oracular Bubble, the caster is capable of falling down while still being able to charge the spell, making it a somewhat creative ambush option.

[Strategies]
Heal is generally outclassed by the more efficient Great Heal and the significantly stronger Erdtree Heal.

→ While technically only the Prophet and Confessor origins have enough Faith to use this incantation by default, it can still be used to kill a Revenant with any starting Origin's base Faith by using the Two Fingers Heirloom (a Prisoner will need another point in Faith, easiest gained with either Marika's Scarseal or a Commoner's Garb or Commoner's Simple Garb).
All Origins have enough FP to cast this incantation at least 3 times without using a Flask of Cerulean Tears, provided they haven't used FP for anything too expensive.

Since the anti-revenant effect is applied through what's essentially a 0 Attack Power attack for all other enemies and objects, it can trigger the fire pillars in catacombs to move and remove illusory walls.

items.name: Magic Fortification
items.effect: Increases magic damage negation
items.summary: Magic Fortification is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Two Fingers incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me — the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
effect_details: Magic Fortification grants a Body Buff that decreases Magic damage taken by 35% (10% in PvP) for 90 seconds.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 3,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

notes: Costs 20 FP per cast.
Costs 13 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.

This spell reduces magic damage taken rather than directly increasing damage negation. The total damage reduction can be expressed by the following formula, where MagicFortification represents the effect magnitude: TotalMagicReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - {MagicDamageNegation} \times 0.01) \times (1 - {MagicFortification}))

→ For example, if magic damage negation is 25 at the time of casting, the total reduction against PvE enemies would be 51.25%: TotalMagicReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.35)) = 51.25%
→ Against other players, the total reduction would be 32.5%: TotalMagicReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.10)) = 32.5%
[Strategies]
The effectiveness of this spell diminishes as magic damage negation increases, offering less benefit when stacked with multiple magic negation sources.
Magic Fortification is a moderately effective defensive spell with low casting requirements, usable by most starting Origins when equipped with the Two Fingers Heirloom and a Finger Seal.
This incantation is valuable due to the prevalence of Magic damage in the game, particularly against sorcerers, Deathbirds, and Glintstone Dragons, especially in regions like Liurnia of the Lakes.

Magic Fortification offers greater magic protection than Spellproof Dried Liver (35% vs. 15%) but at a shorter duration (90 vs. 120 seconds). This spell requires 10 Faith and 1 Memory Slot to be equipped and 20 FP to cast, while the Dried Liver only requires crafting materials.
→ The Spellproof Dried Liver is preferable for PvP encounters, as both effects are reduced to 10%.

effect_details: Grants a Body Buff that decreases Magic damage taken by 60% (20% in PvP) for 70 seconds for caster and allies within a 6 meter radius.

details: Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling back and forth on the path patrolled by a Crucible Tree Knight, north of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace, past the elevator downwards.

notes: Costs 13 points of Stamina to cast.

Overall a very strong defensive incantation, if one that comes a bit late and will most likely come after the Magic-heavy area of Liurnia of the Lakes, with only the Astels and Loretta being the major Magic damage bosses left.

Since it doesn't actually apply a flat increase to damage negation, just the damage taken, the actual effective new damage negation (the one shown on the character screen) can be calculated with the following formula: 1 - (1 - (current Magic damage negation)/100) * (1 - 0.60).
→ As an example, if Magic damage negation before casting the incantation is 25.000 the result becomes this: 1 - (1 - 25.000/100) * (1 - 0.60) = 0.7, or 70.0% Magic damage negation.
→ Against other players, simply replace the 0.60 with 0.20 for a new end result of 40.0% Magic damage negation.

Overall a very strong defensive incantation, and one that comes just before the final Lightning-heavy area in the game, Crumbling Farum Azula, and the Dragonlord, one of the more Lightning-focused bosses in the game.

Since it doesn't actually apply a flat increase to damage negation, just the damage taken, the actual effective new damage negation (the one shown on the character screen) can be calculated with the following formula: 1 - (1 - (current Lightning damage negation)/100) * (1 - 0.60).
→ As an example, if Lightning damage negation before casting the incantation is 25.000 the result becomes this: 1 - (1 - 25.000/100) * (1 - 0.60) = 0.7, or 70.0% Lightning damage negation.
→ Against other players, simply replace the 0.60 with 0.20 for a new end result of 40.0% Lightning damage negation.
Since it's effectively the damage taken that is reduced, the higher Lightning damage negation stat a character has before casting the spell the less effective it may appear to be in the statistics.

items.name: Protection of the Erdtree
items.japanese_name: 黄金樹の護り (Ōgonju no Mamori)
items.effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies
items.summary: Protection of the Erdtree is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Erdtree Worship incantations.
items.description:
A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship.

Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
effect_details: Protection of the Erdtree grants a Body Buff that decreases Fire, Holy, Lightning, and Magic damage taken by 30% (10% in PvP) for 70 seconds for the caster and allies within a 6-meter radius.

details: Protection of the Erdtree is obtained upon defeating a Teardrop Scarab located on a square platform upon a hill southeast of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.

notes: Costs 30 FP per cast.
Costs 50 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.

This spell reduces damage taken rather than directly increasing damage negation. The total damage reduction can be expressed by the following formula, where ProtectionOfTheErdtree represents the effect magnitude: TotalAffinityReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - {AffinityDamageNegation} \times 0.01) \times (1 - {ProtectionOfTheErdtree}))

→ For example, if affinity damage negation is 25 at the time of casting, the total reduction against PvE enemies would be 51.25%: TotalAffinityReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.30)) = 51.25%
→ Against other players, the total reduction would be 32.5%: TotalAffinityReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.10)) = 32.5%

text: Protection of the Erdtree is a versatile defensive incantation that protects both the caster and allies from multiple damage types, making it invaluable in more varied combat scenarios.

→ Available earlier than other defensive incantations that also affect nearby allies, as it can be accessed from the beginning of the game if players brave the path toward Altus Plateau. In contrast, other shareable defensive buffs are found later in the game, either at the end of Leyndell, Royal Capital or after it.

→ Unlike other advanced defensive incantations, Flame, Protect Me only affects the caster. Therefore, Protection of the Erdtree is the only way to grant nearby allies protection specifically against Fire damage.
This spell is particularly useful against enemies that deal multiple types of elemental damage, like Rellana, Twin Moon Knight and Bayle the Dread.

While it is the weakest defensive Body Buff incantation, it strengthens all non-Physical damage negations, making it useful as a Furled Finger for not having to carry multiple defensive incantations when summoned via Summoning Pools.

Compared to Opaline Pickled Liver Shadow of the Erdtree, this incantation is roughly twice as strong (+30% vs +18% Non-Physical Damage Negation, or +10% vs +6% against other players) and also applies to allies within 7 meters of the caster, while lasting roughly half as long (70 vs 120 seconds), requiring a Sacred Seal and FP to cast (30 vs 0 FP), and needing Faith to use (35 vs 0 Faith).

items.summary: Elden Stars is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Erdtree incantations.
items.description:
This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.

Creates a stream of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

It is said that long ago, the Greater Will sent a golden star bearing a beast into the Lands Between, which would later become the Elden Ring.
effect_details: This spell sends out a golden orb that tracks its target while shooting out small projectiles with Holy Attack Power equal to 20% of Incantation Scaling. Upon making contact with a surface or enemy, the orb explodes, dealing Holy Attack Power equal to 199% of Incantation Scaling and hitting a 4.2-meter radius around the point of impact.

details: Elden Stars can be looted from a body at the end of a cave filled with giant ants in the Deeproot Depths, located immediately west of the Great Waterfall Crest grace, after climbing up one of the large roots.

notes: Costs 41 FP per cast.
Costs 48 Stamina per cast.
Requires 2 Memory Slots to be equipped.
Deals 14 Stance damage with the explosion and 0.5 Stance damage per mini-projectile that hits.
[Boosting]
Sacred Scorpion Charm boosts the Attack Power by 12% (8% in PvP).
Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear increases Holy damage dealt by 20% (15% in PvP) for 3 minutes.
[Strategies]
The small projectiles sent out by the main orb deal extremely low damage and are mainly useful for harassing other players with constant incoming damage ticks.

→ The reason that the damage is so much lower than the difference in Attack Power suggests is because defense reduces the damage of attacks with relatively lower Attack Power much more than those with relatively high Attack Power.
Generally a rather ineffective spell that is mostly useful for pressuring other players in PvP scenarios.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased FP consumption.
patch_notes.community_notes: The FP cost was decreased from 47 to 41.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased cast speed and decreased recovery time

items.name: Black Blade
items.effect: Black blade spinning slash that emits wave of light
items.summary: Black Blade is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Erdtree Incantations.
items.description:
Power gleaned from the remembrance of Maliketh.

Caster creates an illusory black blade, then leaps forward to deliver a spinning slash that emits a wave of light. This can be followed up with one additional attack.

This blade was once imbued with Destined Death. In addition to dealing damage, it reduces foes' maximum HP and continues to sap their current HP for a very short time.
effect_details: Summons a red, spectral version of Maliketh's Black Blade, then jumps and spins forwards with the blade to hit for Holy Attack Power equal to 225% of Incantation Scaling while also sending out a wave with Holy Attack Power equal to 162% of Incantation Scaling.

If the incantation is used again immediately afterwards, the second sword's Attack Power is increased to 232% of Incantation Scaling while the beam's Attack Power is increased to 169% of Incantation Scaling for the second cast.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, dropped by Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

notes: Costs 44 points of Stamina to perform, with the follow-up costing the same amount of Stamina for a total of 88 points of Stamina if both parts are used.
The sword part deals 9 Stance damage and the beam part deals 4 Stance damage.

Both the sword itself and the wave it sends out can hit the same target at melee range, meaning that the first cast effectively can have Attack Power roughly equal to 387% of Incantation Scaling while the follow-up cast can have Attack Power equal to 401% of Incantation Scaling.

The beam attack applies two debuffs: the first deals damage equal to 0.1% of the target's maximum HP + 1 every 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds (total damage equal to 2% of target's maximum HP + 20) while the second debuff lowers the target's maximum HP by 10% for 15 seconds, signified by a part of their health bar being blocked out with grey.

→ The debuff that lowers maximum HP doesn't stack with the Maliketh's Black Blade's skill Destined Death similar debuff, but it does stack with the one inflicted by the Black Knife's skill Blade of Death.

infobox.item_effect: Black blade spinning slash that emits wave of light

items.name: Discus of Light
items.effect: Fires ring of light before the caster
items.summary: Discus of Light is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Produces a ring of light and fires it forwards. The ring of light returns to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
effect_details: Throws out a ring of light with Holy Attack Power equal to 150% of Incantation Scaling and going through foes, stopping when it reaches its maximum range or hits an object.
The ring begins to return to the caster shortly after arriving at its destination, having the same Attack Power for its attack against all foes it passes through.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 11,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Goldmask's location in Altus.

Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation after moving to Goldmask's location, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: If Corhyn dies before this incantation appears in his inventory then it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast.
Attack Power is boosted by 10% per Golden Order Seal held in an active hand (2 max) and by 15% per Dryleaf Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
→ Since it's possible to acquire both of these Seals in one Playthrough, it's one of a few spells able to stack Seal boosts (for a total boost of 27% in this case).
Wearing the Radiant Gold Mask increases Attack Power by 10%.
Effectively has Attack Power roughly equal to 300% of Incantation Scaling per cast since it will very often hit the main target on the way back.
Several rings can be out at the same time, making the spell very spammable.

Pairs well with the Erdtree Greatshield's skill Golden Retaliation and the Ash of War: Carian Retaliation since the timing of the returning ring is very predictable and will trigger the spell-parry-into-projectile part of those skills.
Can be cast while riding Torrent, further extending the incantation's usability and ability to be spammed.

The caster takes a short step forwards each time the spell is cast. While many steep falls prevent a character from stepping over them from movement caused by Skills, Spells, and Weapons, it's still good to be a bit careful.
Though it goes through all enemies it will not ignore the damage reduction from an enemy that is keeping its guard up if they are guarding in the direction it's flying from.
→ Note that it will still fly through said guarding enemy and will hit their unprotected back when returning unless said enemy turns around in between the two hits.

items.name: Triple Rings of Light
items.effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster
items.summary: Triple Rings of Light is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
effect_details: Throws out 3 wide rings of light in a 90-degree arc that has Holy Attack Power equal to 155% of Incantation Scaling and pierces through enemies, stopping upon hitting an object. They still cause damage when stopped and return to the caster 2 seconds after stopping, having the same amount of Attack Power on the returning hit.

details: Found in a treasure chest in a room locked by an Imp Statue located at the lower level near the Prayer Room Site of Grace.

notes: Costs 28 points of Stamina to cast.
Deals 3 Stance damage per hit, for up to 9 Stance damage if all hits land.
Attack Power is boosted by 10% per Golden Order Seal held in an active hand (2 max) and by 15% per Dryleaf Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
→ Since it's possible to acquire both of these Seals in one Playthrough, it's one of a few spells able to stack Seal boosts (for a total boost of 27% in this case).
Wearing the Radiant Gold Mask increases Attack Power by 10%.
Effectively has Attack Power equal to 310% of Incantation Scaling per ring since it will very often hit the main target on the way back.
→ Can potentially hit with Attack Power equal to 465% of Incantation Scaling if the target is also standing at the incantation's maximum range or at a hit object (or hit ground).

→ Note that the rings share hit registration, meaning an enemy can only be hit up to 3 times: once when the ring is thrown out, a second time when it's stopped, and a third possible hit when the rings return.
Several rings can be out at the same time, making the spell very spammable.
→ If casting the spell sequentially, the first set of rings will start to return as the second set is being thrown out.

Pairs decently well with the Erdtree Greatshield's skill Golden Retaliation and the Ash of War: Carian Retaliation since the timing of the returning ring is very predictable and will trigger the spell-parry-into-projectile part of those skills.

The caster takes a short step forwards each time the spell is cast. While many steep falls prevent a character from stepping over them from movement caused by Skills, Spells, and Weapons, it's still good to be a bit careful.
Though it goes through all enemies, it will not ignore the damage reduction from an enemy that is keeping its guard up if they are guarding in the direction it's flying from.
→ Note that it will still fly through said guarding enemy and will hit their unprotected back when returning unless said enemy turns around in between the two hits.

items.name: Radagon's Rings of Light
items.japanese_name: ラダゴンの光輪 (Radagon no Kōrin)
items.effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area
items.summary: Radagon's Rings of Light is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A gift of gratitude to the young Miquella from his father, Radagon.

Produces a golden ring of light and fires it across a wide area. Charging enhances range.

And yet, the young Miquella abandoned fundamentalism, for it could do nothing to treat Malenia's accursed rot. This was the beginning of unalloyed gold.
effect_details: Creates a halo of light above the caster's head, which is then thrown out as an expanding ring of light around them, with Holy Attack Power equal to 310% of Incantation Scaling.
Charging the spell increases the Attack Power to 395% of Incantation Scaling.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia.

Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: Should both Corhyn and Miriel die before giving either of them the prayerbook then this incantation becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Costs 37 points of Stamina to cast. Charging the spell increases the cost to 48 points of Stamina.
Deals 10 Stance damage on a hit, increasing to 14 Stance damage if charged.
Attack Power is boosted by 10% per Golden Order Seal held in an active hand (2 max) and by 15% per Dryleaf Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
→ Since it's possible to acquire both of these Seals in one Playthrough, it's one of a few spells able to stack Seal boosts (for a total boost of 27% in this case).
Wearing the Radiant Gold Mask increases Attack Power by 10%.
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 27%, wearing this talisman increases Attack Power by a total of 46%.
While its large hitbox would seem able to hit large targets multiple times, it can actually only hit a target once.
→ This makes it less able to hit weak spots on large foes, since the large hitbox can fairly easily hit another, non-weak body part beforehand.

items.name: Multilayered Ring of Light
items.effect: Fires a multilayered golden ring of light that continuously inflicts damage
items.summary: Multilayered Ring of Light is an incantation spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one of Miquella's Incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of those who served Miquella.

Produces a multilayered golden ring of light and fires it forwards, inflicting continuous damage on those struck by it. Charging increases potency.

This light-ring incantation was cultivated by a tradition separate from Golden Order fundamentalism.
effect_details: Throws out a ring of light with Holy Attack Power equal to 200% of Incantation Scaling on impact. The ring stops and expands when it touches an enemy or an object, hitting with Holy Attack Power equal to 40% of Incantation Scaling 7 times over 2 seconds.

Charging the incantation increases the Attack Power to 250% of Incantation Scaling on the initial hit and to 45% of Incantation Scaling for the smaller hits, while also increasing the number of follow-up hits to 9 over 3 seconds.

details: Defeat the Phantom Misbegotten Warrior found past the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace along the main path through the area.

notes: Costs 28 points of Stamina to cast. The cost increases to 36 points of Stamina if charged.

Deals 8 Stance damage on the initial hit and 1.5 Stance damage per expanded hit (for a total of 18.5 Stance damage if both the initial hit and all expanded hits land). Initial Stance damage increases to 10 if charged, raising the total Stance damage to 23.5 if all hits land.
Attack Power is boosted by 15% per Dryleaf Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.

→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 25% for the initial hit and 12% for the follow-up hits (36% total), wearing this talisman raises Attack Power by a total of 44% for the initial hit and 29% for the follow-up hits (57% total).

Can deal damage equal to 480% of Incantation Scaling (655% of Incantation Scaling if charged), assuming no flat defense or damage negation on an enemy. Typically, it deals damage closer to 360% of Incantation Scaling (450% of Incantation Scaling if charged), assuming 0% damage negation due to flat defense having a disproportionate negative effect on the damage of the weaker follow-up hits.
Attack Power is not boosted by the Circlet of Light.

items.name: Litany of Proper Death
items.japanese_name: 死を正す聖律 (Shi wo Tadasu Seiritsu)
items.effect: Creates image of Order to deal holy damage
items.summary: Litany of Proper Death is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Creates an image of Order, dealing holy damage to nearby foes. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason – all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
effect_details: Causes the user to cross their arms before performing a T-like pose to unleash a medium-ranged wave of crossing lights on the ground with Holy Attack Power equal to 56% of Incantation Scaling.
Has a massive 900% Attack Power bonus against Those Who Live in Death, effectively making it have Holy Attack Power equal to 560% of Incantation Scaling against them.

details: Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 2,500 Runes after speaking to Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum.

notes: Costs 28 points of Stamina to cast.
Attack Power is increased by 10% per Golden Order Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Wearing the Radiant Gold Mask increases Attack Power by 10%.
Deals low damage overall against non-weak enemies, with only the massive Attack Power bonus against undead making it deal enough damage to actually be somewhat usable.
The damage vector is very groundbound and can be stopped by changes in elevation.
Skeletons defeated by this spell are immediately killed and cannot resurrect themselves.
The reach is somewhat hard to judge visually, with the clear golden sheen ending after about one-third to one-half of the range.

infobox.item_effect: Creates image of Order to deal holy damage
infobox.obtained: Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead

items.name: Order Healing
items.effect: Alleviates death blight buildup
items.summary: Order Healing is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Alleviates death blight buildup.

The noble Goldmask lamented what had become of the hunters. How easy it is for learning and learnedness to be reduced to the ravings of fanatics; all the good and the great wanted, in their foolishness, was an absolute evil to contend with.

Does such a notion exist in the fundamentals of Order?
effect_details: Removes all Death Blight build-up on the user.

details: Drops from a Scarab found in the circular room in the southeastern quarter of Siofra Aqueduct, past the Crucible Tree Knight.

notes: Costs 10 points of Stamina to cast.

One of only two things in the game specifically aimed at removing Death Blight alongside Rejuvenating Boluses, though the Speckled Hardtear and Law of Regression can also remove it (though the Hardtear only works once before having to rest at a Site of Grace again and Regression also removes beneficial effects on the user and allies, and negative effects on enemies).

Can potentially be used by any starting Origin even without investment in Intelligence and Faith by wearing the Stargazer Heirloom and Two Fingers Heirloom talismans (Prisoners and Astrologers can drop the former while Confessors and Prophets can drop the latter).

infobox.item_effect: Alleviates death blight buildup

items.name: Order's Blade
items.effect: Enchanted right-hand armament with holy damage
items.summary: Order's Blade is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
effect_details: Grants the right-hand weapon a Weapon Buff giving bonus Holy Attack Power equal to 75% of the Faith scaling of the Sacred Seal used to cast it for 90 seconds.
Also grants the weapon a 100% damage bonus against Those Who Live in Death and immediately kills Skeletons after defeating them, preventing their resurrection mechanic.

details: Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 3,000 Runes after speaking to Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum.

notes: Costs 10 points of Stamina to cast.

Despite being a Golden Order Incantation, this spell, like other spell-based weapon buffs, does not get bonus damage from its associated seal (the Golden Order Seal for this one). Additionally, said seal is actually rather bad for casting this spell as its Intelligence scaling will not be used for the weapon buff's strength.

The moderate investment in Intelligence required for this spell is somewhat inconvenient since it does not help its scaling. The best way to cast this in limited situations is to equip the Stargazer Heirloom with an innate Intelligence of 8-12. This is possible for every Origin without an Intelligence investment, except for the Hero and the Prophet, both of which have a 7 in that Attribute.
The anti-undead bonus only applies to direct weapon hits, except for the winds from the skills Storm Assault and Stormcaller since those mechanically count as direct weapon hits.
Like with all spell-based Weapon Buffs, it can only be cast when a weapon is held in the right hand and the casting implement in the left hand.
→ If you wish to buff two weapons at the same time, see below for similar skills.
Outmatched by Holy Grease below 114 Incantation Scaling, by Skill: Sacred Blade below 120 Incantation Scaling, and by Golden Grease Shadow of the Erdtree below 160 Incantation Scaling.

→ Though they cast much quicker and last for a shorter duration, Drawstring Holy Grease is stronger below 147 Incantation Scaling while Drawstring Golden Grease Shadow of the Erdtree is stronger below 180 Incantation Scaling.
→ Sacred Blade has the advantage of also being usable for weapons with the otherwise unbuffable (not counting other skills) Lightning and Sacred Affinity weapons.

items.name: Immutable Shield
items.effect: Increases left-hand shield's affinity/ailment resistance
items.summary: Immutable Shield is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Enchants the shield held in the left hand with the light of regression, increasing all forms of non-Physical damage negation and ailment resistance.

Two concepts form the basis for Golden Order fundamentalism. One is the law of regression, to which this incantation relates.
effect_details: Grants a Shield Buff-type Weapon Buff to a left-handed shield for 30 seconds that nullifies all non-Physical damage and Status Effects from attacks when guarding.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold by Brother Corhyn for 10,000 Runes after telling Goldmask that Radagon is Marika.

Should Corhyn die but before purchasing this Incantation after solving Goldmask's puzzle, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: If Corhyn dies before this incantation appears in his inventory then it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Costs 10 points of Stamina to cast.

infobox.item_effect: Increases left-hand shield's affinity/ailment resistance

items.name: Law of Causality
items.effect: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows
items.summary: Law of Causality is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals.

Manifests a small ring of causality within that allows the caster to automatically retaliate upon receiving a certain number of blows.

The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Causality is the pull between meanings; that which links all things in a chain of relation.
effect_details: Grants a unique Buff that lasts for 120 seconds. If the buffed target is damaged 5 times in a short time period (no more than 7 seconds passing between each hit), they explode, hitting for 487 Holy Attack Power against all enemies within a 4-meter radius.

details: Given by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood and choosing to talk "About the Lord of Blood's Cocoon".
Can also be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 5,000 Runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast.
Deals 7 Stance damage.

Since the buff caster has to take damaging hits to trigger the effect, shields with 100% Guarded Damage Negation can prevent the effect from activating. Shields with almost but not quite 100% Guarded Damage Negation (such as the Lordsworn's Shield and its 94% Guarded Damage Negation against Physical damage) can minimize the damage needed.
The final hit for the buffed can be triggered during a roll or another effect that reduces damage taken to 0. If this happens, the explosion's damage is also reduced to 0.
Does not scale at all with Incantation Scaling, meaning its damage can only be increased with effects that can buff general damage, incantation damage, and Holy damage.
The Broken Gold Mask helm passively boosts the damage of this incantation by 15%.

infobox.item_effect: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows

items.name: Law of Regression
items.effect: Heals all ailments and dispels all special effects
items.summary: Law of Regression is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Golden Order Incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals.

Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms.

The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.
effect_details: Removes the Status Effects, Buffs, and Debuffs from the caster and allies and enemies within a radius of 15 meters and also dispels all active spells within that effect radius.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia.

Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: Should both Corhyn and Miriel die before giving them the prayerbook then this incantation becomes unavailable for that character for the rest of that Journey.

notes: Costs 50 points of Stamina to cast.
The requirements of the Sacred Seal don't need to be met to cast this spell, making it usable with no Faith investment.

Surprisingly useful for crossing the Lake of Rot. While it's slower to cast than other spells and items, it's still somewhat useful for characters with high medium to high Intelligence but without the Faith needed for Flame, Cleanse Me or the materials for Preserving Boluses.
Be careful when using it near allies so it doesn't remove their beneficial effects.

Needed for Goldmask's quest: Reveals a secret referenced by Miriel, Pastor of Vows when used while standing on top of the unknown artist's Wizened Finger message in front of the Radagon statue in Leyndell, Royal Capital, just outside of the Erdtree Sanctuary. Once you have revealed the secret message, you will be able to tell Goldmask about it to progress Brother Corhyn's quest.
→ Any character can meet the Intelligence requirement to cast this spell, see the below chart for Int boosting options:

With Godrick's Great Rune active, Marika's Scarseal, the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear, the Stargazer Heirloom, and the Twinsage Glintstone Crown, a character with 8 intelligence can reach the 37 Intelligence needed (5+3+10+5+6+8). A character with 7 intelligence will instead need to either invest one point into int, meet 27 Str for the Grafted Blade Greatsword, obtain the late game item Marika's Soreseal, or respec stats with Rennala.

items.summary: Light of Miquella is an incantation spell in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one of Miquella's Incantations.
items.description:
The strength of Miquella upon his deific return, wielded as an incantation.

Annihilates foes with a pillar of light.

Miquella sought to accept all that was and would be, but found one that refused to be embraced.

No wonder, as one god and one king consort, is all the world needs.
effect_details: Summons a circle of light that explodes after 3 seconds into a pillar of light for Holy Attack Power equal to 375% of Incantation Scaling over a 6-meter radius.
1 second after the large pillar of light explodes, smaller pillars of light with a radius of 1 meter and with Holy Attack Power equal to 70% of Incantation Scaling are created in the affected area.

acquisition.location: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

notes: Costs 60 points of Stamina to cast.
The large pillar of light deals 20 Stance damage, while the smaller ones deal 2 Stance damage per hit.
Wearing the Circlet of Light increases the Attack Power by 10%.
The incantation is guaranteed to complete after the circle of light is created, even if the caster is knocked out of the casting animation before the first pillar of light has time to explode.

Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.

items.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
items.japanese_name: ヴァイクの竜雷 (Vaiku no Ryūrai)
items.effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage
items.summary: Vyke's Dragonbolt is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Dragon Cult Incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

Summons red lightning to bolster both the caster's body and their armament held in the right hand. Enchants armament with lightning-affinity attacks and increases maximum equipment load. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced.

Of all the knights, Vyke the Dragonspear was the one Lansseax loved the most.
effect_details: A bolt of red lightning strikes down on the caster's weapon, granting them a Weapon Buff that gives Lightning Attack Power equal to 75% of Faith-based Incantation Scaling and a Body Buff that increases maximum Equip Load by 15% but lowers Lightning Damage Negation.
Both buffs last for 70 seconds.

details: Vyke's Dragonbolt is acquired from the defeat of Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast.
The Weapon Buff and the Body Buff are separate effects, meaning that the Body Buff remains active if the Weapon Buff is deactivated and vice versa.

→ The effective change to current Equip Load depends on how high the Equip Load was beforehand. To compare, someone at 30% Equip Load would have it lowered to 26.1%, someone at 70% Equip Load would have it lowered to 60.9%, and someone at 100% Equip Load would have it lowered to 87%.

This spell can only be cast if the wielded right-hand weapon can be buffed by spells, though the Body Buff can still be taken advantage of by keeping a light, buffable weapon such as a Dagger or Caestus in an extra weapon slot.
Lightning damage is fairly rare outside of Leyndell, Royal Capital and Crumbling Farum Azula, making the downside of the Body Buff often irrelevant unless fighting other players.
The Weapon Buff portion is equally as strong as Electrify Armament.
Outmatched by Lightning Grease and Skill: Lightning Slash below 114 Incantation Scaling and by Dragonbolt Grease Shadow of the Erdtree below 160 Incantation Scaling.

→ Though they cast much quicker and last for a shorter duration, Drawstring Lightning Grease is stronger below 147 Incantation Scaling while Drawstring Dragonbolt Grease Shadow of the Erdtree is stronger below 180 Incantation Scaling.
→ Lightning Slash has the advantage of also being usable for weapons with the otherwise unbuffable (not counting other skills) Lightning and Sacred Affinity weapons.

items.name: Dragonbolt of Florissax
items.japanese_name: フローサクスの竜雷 (Furōsakusu no Ryūrai)
items.effect: Calls down red lightning to bolster self and nearby allies
items.summary: Dragonbolt of Florissax is an incantation spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one of the Dragon Cult incantations.
items.description:
Special incantation of the ancient dragon Florissax.

Calls down red lightning to bolster the caster and nearby allies. While enrobed with red lightning, all forms of damage negation (including physical) are increased. This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect.

There was a time when the priestess never knew love, and thus never used this incantation herself.
effect_details: Increases the Damage Negation by 10% (5% in PvP) for the user and allies within 7 meters, and also decreases damage taken when Guarding by 20%.
Counts as an Aura Buff and lasts for 70 seconds.

details: Given by the Dragon Communion Priestess at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after giving her Thiollier's Concoction at night and waiting for her to wake up (and then repeatedly talking to her), and then finally defeating Bayle the Dread.
→ This item is mutually exclusive with the Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel.
→ Continue talking to her and both confess to be the one that put her to sleep and accept her into your service to receive the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ash.

→ Since this requires Thiollier's Concoction, make sure to get that item by giving him the Black Syrup from Moore at Belurat, Tower Settlement (obtained by speaking to both of them several times) and then giving the Syrup to Thiollier BEFORE defeating the Putrescent Knight or approaching Shadow Keep too closely.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast.

Since this is an Aura Buff, it has to compete with the Golden Vow spell, which it compares rather unfavorably towards as that one grants a stronger Damage Negation bonus and a Damage bonus, and takes considerably less Faith to use.
The reduction to damage taken through blocking is applied after the damage has already been reduced by the blocking equipment's own Blocking Damage Negation.
Also used by Ancient Dragon Florissax, though a new Journey must be started to attain both on the same character.
→ Be wary that Florissax can overwrite a possibly more beneficial Aura Buff cast by someone else.

items.name: Golden Arcs
items.effect: Releases a procession of golden arcs with a swing of the arm
items.summary: Golden Arcs is a spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It's one of the Spiral Incantations.
items.description:
Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

A swing of the arm releases a procession of golden arcs. Charging enhances potency.

The arcs resemble barbs, a known symbol of coercive questioning.
effect_details: Send out 3 swift, small golden arcs with a sweep of the arm, each having Holy Attack Power equal to 80% of Incantation Scaling (equal to 240% of Incantation Scaling in total).
Charging the spell increases the Attack Power per arc to 95% of Incantation Scaling (285% of the same in total).

details: Found in an already opened chest within the pit in Moorth Ruins in a shrine guarded by three Inquisitors.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast. Charging increases the cost to 26 points.
Deals 5 Stance damage per hit (15 in total).
Attack Power is boosted by 20% per Spiraltree Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 19%, wearing this talisman increases the Attack Power by a total of 37%.
Since the Attack Power per arc is somewhat mediocre, the damage may be somewhat lower than expected.
Surprisingly great Stance damage, especially if using the quicker uncharged casting.

items.name: Giant Golden Arc
items.effect: Releases a giant golden arc with a swing of the arm
items.summary: Giant Golden Arc is a spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It's one of the Spiral Incantations.
items.description:
Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

A swing of the arm releases a giant golden arc. Charging enhances potency.

The arc resembles the barb, a known symbol of coercive questioning.
effect_details: Send out a large, slow golden arc with a sweep of the arm and that has Holy Attack Power equal to 215% of Incantation Scaling.
Charging the spell increases the Attack Power per arc to 265% of Incantation Scaling.

details: Found in the Ruins of Unte, within the courtyard blocked by a deactivated Furnace Golem. Reactivate the Furnace Golem with a Hefty Furnace Pot thrown from the top of one of the outer ruins in order to enter the courtyard. The incantation can be found in a chest within the courtyard shrine.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast. Charging increases the cost to 26 points.
Deals 8 Stance damage. Increases to 12 Stance damage if charged.
Attack Power is boosted by 20% per Spiraltree Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 23%, wearing this talisman increases the Attack Power by a total of 42%.

Since the incantation actually works by having a single "bullet" at the center that sends out the rest of the golden arc, it actually usually fares pretty well in tight tunnels and other restrictive areas.

items.name: Spira
items.effect: Summons a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet
items.summary: Spira is a spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It's one of the Spiral Incantations.
items.description:
Superior sorcery of the tower priests, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

Wrap one's arms together and hold them up to the heavens to summon a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet. Column of light persists for as long as the button is pressed.

The spiral is a normalized Crucible current that, one day, will form a column that stretches to the gods.
effect_details: Clasp hands in prayer and then raise them to create a sigil that explodes after a moment, with the explosion having Holy Attack Power equal to 160% of Incantation Scaling.
Continue channeling the incantation to keep the hands raised and send out more pillars, but with less delay between them.

details: From the First Rise Site of Grace, pass the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors and go up the stairs. Thereafter, find a way to walk on the branches to cross over to the platform with the single praying Inquisitor.

notes: Costs 14 points of Stamina per cast.
Deals 3 Stance damage per hit.
Attack Power is boosted by 20% per Spiraltree Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Has some vertical reach, enough to hit a Dragon's head when it's walking.
Since there is a short delay between the sigil being created and the pillar erupting, it's very easy to miss foes moving quicker than a walking pace.
Requires line of sight between the caster and the target, as the sigil is actually created by an invisible bullet sent out from the caster.

items.name: Watchful Spirit
items.effect: Summons a guardian spirit above the caster's head
items.summary: Watchful Spirit is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Divine Beast incantations.
items.description:
An entreaty received from the hornsent grandam.

Summon a guardian spirit above the caster's head. The spirit never strays far from the caster, conjuring several apparitions before dissipating.

"Take vengeance upon Messmer and his lot. They who betrayed us, aye, they who burned us... Let them face in thy wrath their just deserts."
effect_details: Slowly summons a floating skull above the caster's head, which then shoots 4 projectiles with Holy Attack Power equal to 100% of Incantation Scaling each, one after another.

details: Gained by speaking to the Hornsent Grandam twice while wearing the Divine Beast Head.

→ She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom Key on your left. She is on the right side of that room.
→ Must be done before defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast.
Very slow to cast, taking roughly 2 seconds to summon.
Wearing the Braided Cord Robe increases Attack Power by 15%.
Low damage overall, making it not that useful.

Cannot be used simultaneously with Glintblade Phalanx, Carian Phalanx, Greatblade Phalanx, Skill: Glintblade Phalanx, or Unique Skill: Tremendous Phalanx Shadow of the Erdtree, as they will override each other.

items.name: Divine Bird Feathers
items.effect: Spreads arms like wings and releases a flurry of feathers
items.summary: Divine Bird Feathers is an Incantation Spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one the Divine Beast incantations.
items.description:
A technique of the divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, wielded as an incantation.

Spread the arms wide like wings to release a flurry of feathers. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to continue releasing feathers.

The divine bird warriors, and indeed this technique, are said to bear resemblance to the golden Crucible.
effect_details: The user spreads their arms and then points them forward to launch a continuous barrage of sharp feathers, hitting with Pierce Attack Power equal to 53% of Incantation Scaling per hit. Launches and can hit ("ticks") every 0.1 seconds.
This incantation can be continually cast by holding down the casting button.
The user can move at walking speed while casting.

details: Divine Bird Feathers is looted from a body at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. It is found in a body of water just east of the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance site of grace. To reach it, head north from the grace and keep to the right in the temple to arrive at the pool, where it's on a body just past a stone gazebo.

notes: Costs 3 FP per cast.
Costs 3 Stamina per cast.
Wearing the Divine Bird Helm will boost the Attack Power by 10%.
Divine Bird Feathers is incredibly weak due to its very low Attack Power being heavily mitigated by enemies' flat defenses. Additionally, it will quickly drain FP.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased attack power.
patch_notes.community_notes: Increased incantation scaling from 42 to 53.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased the minimum delay between consecutive hits. Increased range.
patch_notes.community_notes: Reduced the delay between hits, as feathers are launched every 0.1 second but before this patch each enemy could only be damaged once every 0.3 seconds.

items.name: Divine Beast Tornado
items.effect: Summons a storm that launches a tornado forward
items.summary: Divine Beast Tornado is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Divine Beast incantations.
items.description:
The tempest of the Dancing Lion, wielded as an incantation.

A whirlwind-like twist of the body summons a storm, launching a tornado forward. Charging enhances potency.

The majority of divine beasts were gored and hung upon Messmer's spears, then burned in his flame. Those who witnessed the deed likened it to a funeral pyre for the tower itself.
effect_details: Swirls around twice to gather winds, then throws them forwards in a storm to create a tornado at the endpoint, hitting with Standard Attack Power equal to 220% of Incantation Scaling along the way and at the end.
Can be charged to increase Attack Power to 275% of Incantation Scaling and to launch hit foes.

details: Drops from the Divine Beast Dancing Lion found by heading east-northeast across the bridge beginning at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace.
→ The temple's location is just northeast of the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace but isn't reachable from that spot.

→ The Grand Stairway grace can be found by heading into the temple southwest of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace and taking a left after the stairs down to find an elevator. Then, turn 180 degrees to the left to find some thin walkways to walk on and drop to a second set underneath them. Continue on the path until you see a small room marked with two torch-pillars to find the elevator to the Stairway grace.

notes: Costs 20 points of Stamina to cast. Charging the spell increases the cost to 26 points of Stamina.
Deals 8 Stance damage with the tornado itself, and 3 Stance damage with the staggering winds cast when starting the incantation.
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 25%, the total Attack Power increase is 44%.
Deals much more damage if an enemy is hit at the edge of this spell's range, where the tornado lingers, since they will be hit by the traveling hitbox and the end hitbox.

Note that there is no hyperarmor when casting this spell, and the hitbox from the start-up animation will only stagger very weak enemies. This, combined with the greatest damage happening at the edge of its range, means that this incantation should be cast when far away from enemies.

items.name: Catch Flame
items.effect: Momentarily sparks flame from hand
items.summary: Catch Flame is an incantation in Elden Ring. It is one of the Flame incantations.
items.description:
Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy.

Momentarily sparks flame from the caster's hand. This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action.

The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.
effect_details: Conjure a small burst of flames from the hand, that has Fire Attack Power equal to 225% of Incantation Scaling.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 600 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.
Starting equipment for the Prophet Origin.

notes: Costs 10 FP per cast.
Costs 17 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.
Deals 7 Stance damage.
Can be chain-cast continuously, provided the player has sufficient amounts of FP.
Casting this incantation directly after a roll, jump, or backstep makes the casting time slightly shorter, making it much more dynamic than many other, slower spells.
Moves the caster slightly forward with each use.
Despite using the Giants' Flame, this spell does not generate a spell sigil when cast, making it ineligible for a boost from the Giant's Seal.
[Boosting]
[Strategies]

With its rapid casting time, Catch Flame excels as a quick, close-range option for dispatching enemies. However, its small area of effect and short range make it less reliable against agile or fast-moving targets.

A potent damage-dealing spell throughout the game thanks to its more than decent damage and extremely quick casting time, and available on a lot of Incantations build with only a minimal amount of Faith.
→ It is especially potent as an early-game tool for players who can manage the low FP cost compared to their meager FP pool.
→ Highly efficient as a melee spell for pure Faith builds.
Casting Catch Flame immediately before Magma Breath significantly reduces the cast time of the latter, enabling quicker execution in combat.
→ When chained into Magma Breath mid-air, Catch Flame modifies the casting animation into a faster, more fluid spray, allowing players to seamlessly chain another Magma Breath cast.

items.effect: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand
items.summary: O, Flame! is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Fire Monk incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of the Fire Monks.

Momentarily sparks roaring flame from the caster's hand. Charging enhances potency.

The Giants' Flame still smolders upon the distant northern mountaintop, and the Fire Monks are its guardians.
effect_details: Summons a large, short-ranged burst of flame in hand, with Fire Attack Power equal to 280% Incantation Scaling.
Charging the spell increases Attack Power to 385% of Incantation Scaling.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 6,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook.

Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: Should both Corhyn and Miriel die before giving either of them the prayerbook, this incantation becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Costs 16 FP per cast.
Costs 24 Stamina per cast. Stamina cost increases to 31 when charged.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.
Deals 10.175 Stance damage. Charging the spell increases Stance damage to 14.4.
[Boosting]
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 38%, wearing this talisman increases the Attack Power by a total of 58%.
[Strategies]
Effective in close-range encounters with groups of bunched-up enemies.

Potentially deals a lot of damage when charged, but is somewhat difficult to use to the moderate casting time and needing to be at melee range while lacking the flexibility and agility of Catch Flame.

items.summary: Flame Sling is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Flame incantations.
items.description:
Incantation originating from a sinister prophecy.

Throws a ball of raging fire. Charging enhances potency and causes the ball of fire to explode.

The flame of ruin is anathema to the Erdtree. But prophets sometimes glimpse it within the faith all the same. Sadly, when this occurs their sole reward is banishment.
effect_details: Fling a small ball of fire with Fire Attack Power equal to 202% of Incantation Scaling.
Charging the spell increases the Attack Power to 255% of Incantation Scaling.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 800 Runes by Brother Corhyn.
Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

notes: Costs 11 points of FP to cast.

Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.

Although this spell utilizes the Giants' Flame, its power is not boosted by the Giant's Seal.

An easy to use spell with very early availability that'll provide very good damage throughout the game.

→ Doesn't hold up as well late game since more damaging spells such as Giantsflame Take Thee and Black Flame (especially the latter's maximum HP-based bonus burn damage) will be more useful when FP isn't as precious and kill speed becomes more important.

items.summary: Flame, Fall Upon Them is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Giants' Flame incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Hurls several balls of fire at once. Charging enhances potency and causes the balls of fire to explode.

There is no record of this incantation in common prayerbooks. Only a select few prelates know of its existence.
effect_details: Flings 12 balls of fire each with Fire Attack Power equal to 115% of Incantation Scaling.
Charging the spell increases the Attack Power to 140% of Incantation Scaling.

acquisition.location: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: Sold for 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Giant's Prayerbook.

Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
→ WARNING: Should both Corhyn and Miriel die before giving either of them the prayerbook, this incantation becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Costs 16 FP per cast.
Costs 40 Stamina per cast. Charging the spell increases the cost to 52 points.
→ Technically the Stamina cost is 10 points for the uncharged version and 13 for the charged version, but the cost is taken 4 times.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.
Deals 4 Stance damage per hit (12 at most). Charging the spell increases Stance damage to 6 (18 at most).
The initial fireball will split into 12 after traveling a short distance.

At most 3 of the small fireballs can damage a single target. This limits the effective maximum Attack Power of this spell towards a singlet target to roughtly 345% of Incantation Scaling, or 420% of the same when charged.

[Boosting]

[Strategies]

At close range, only the initial fireball may hit before splitting, so midrange is ideal for landing multiple hits.
The wide spread and AoE of the fireballs can catch evasive enemies, making it useful against invaders or invisible Teardrop Scarabs.

items.name: Flame of the Fell God
items.effect: Summons raging fireball that explodes and sets the area ablaze
items.summary: Flame of the Fell God is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Giants' Flame incantations.
items.description:
This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants.

Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze.

Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.
effect_details: Summons a raging fireball that explodes shortly after coming close to an enemy, with Fire Attack Power equal to 415% of Incantation Scaling and that hits in a 3.5 meter radius, leaving lingering fire spots for 7 seconds that appear to be able to hit about once per second with Fire Attack Power equal to 35% of Incantation Scaling and a 1 meter effect radius.

details: Received upon defeating Adan, Thief of Fire, the boss trapped in the Malefactor's Evergaol.

notes: Costs 34 FP per cast.
Costs 42 Stamina per cast.
Requires 2 Memory Slots to equip.
The projectile is quite large but travels slowly.
Upon detonation, the spell applies a knockback effect to targets.
The explosion deals 16 Stance damage, while each tick from the fire spots deals 1 Stance damage.
Only one Flame of the Fell God can be active per player at a time. Casting a new one will remove the previous fireball, but lingering hazard spots will persist even after a new flame is cast.
[Boosting]
[Strategies]
This spell is highly effective against Erdtree Avatars, as they are weak to Fire and rarely reposition during combat.

The damage of the lingering fire spots is usually reduced to insignificance by an enemy's flat defense. However, their consistent Stance damage can prevent an enemy's Stance from regenerating for up to 7 seconds.

The stamina attack power of the residual flame hazard against guarded enemies was increased from 20 to 40 (to 50 against players). Additionally, their hit frequency was increased to approximately once per second.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased FP cost and increased damage
patch_notes.community_notes: The FP cost was reduced from 50 to 42. The explosion damage of the fireball was increased from 352% to 415% of Incantation Scaling.

One of the incantations of the Fire Monks.

Creates a fire within that burns away toxins. Alleviates poison and scarlet rot buildup and cures these ailments.

This incantation leaves the caster with subtle burns—a reminder that they must fear the flame.

The reason that Frostbite is only removed when fully applied instead of also when it's building up is because the flat HP damage is considered to be Fire damage, and an effect of that damage type is that it removes applied Frostbite.

This incantation is considered vital for navigating swamp areas filled with Poison and Scarlet Rot.

→ The Prophet and Confessor origins have enough base Faith to cast this incantation by default, and all other Origins except Prisoner have enough to cast it at level 1 with only the Two Fingers Heirloom.
→ All Origins also start with enough FP to cast this incantation at least 3 times without using a Flask of Cerulean Tears, provided they haven't used any FP for anything too expensive.

items.summary: Flame, Protect Me is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Fire Monk incantations.
items.description:
The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.

Creates a fire within that greatly increases fire damage negation.

It is said that this incantation was used during the War against the Giants long ago, during which it protected the champions of the Erdtree.
effect_details: Flame, Protect Me applies a Body Buff that increases Fire Damage Negation by 60% (20% in PvP) for 70 seconds.

details: Flame, Protect Me can be found in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave in the Mountaintops of the Giants. It is located behind an imp statue fog wall right next to the dungeon's grace. One Stonesword Key is required to access it.

notes: Costs 30 FP per cast.
Costs 20 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.

This incantation reduces damage taken rather than directly increasing damage negation. The total Fire damage reduction can be expressed by the following formula, where FlameProtect represents the PvE/PvP effect multiplier:
→ TotalFireReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - {FireDamageNegation} \times 0.01) \times (1 - {FlameProtect}))
→ For example, if Fire damage negation is 25 at the time of casting, the total reduction against PvE enemies would be 70%:
→→ TotalFireReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.60)) = 70%
→ Against other players, the total reduction would be 40%:
→→ TotalFireReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.20)) = 40%
[Boosting]
Old Lord's Talisman extends the duration from 70 to 91 seconds.
[Strategies]
Acquired very late, most often after every significant Fire-heavy area and boss except for Mountaintops of the Giants itself and the Fire Giant, and perhaps Dragonlord Placidusax.
→ If doing the Volcano Manor questline to access Praetor Rykard, then he can be fought after acquiring this incantation since the last assassination also takes place in the Mountaintops.
This is the only improved elemental defense buff that doesn't also apply to nearby allies.
→ The only way to also buff nearby allies with Fire Damage Negation is Protection of the Erdtree, which also increases Holy, Lightning, and Magic Damage Negation.

Raises the Attack Power of Physical and Fire attacks by +20% (15% in PvP).
Raises Stamina recovery speed by +5/s.

Costs 16 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.

Old Lord's Talisman increases the duration from 30 to 39 seconds.
[Strategies]
One of the strongest re-usable offensive Body Buffs, if a bit limited in applicable damage types.

→ While it's a very strong buff, it's relatively long casting time and short duration makes it hard to re-cast during combat and makes it best to cast last when Buffing before combat.
Stacks well with offensive Aura Buffs such as Golden Vow spell.

items.name: Fire's Deadly Sin
items.effect: Sets area and self ablaze with raging flames
items.summary: Fire's Deadly Sin is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Flame incantations.
items.description:
Incantation originating from a deeply ominous prophecy.

Sets both the caster and the surrounding area ablaze with raging flames. The caster's body will remain engulfed in flame for a while, burning them and any who draw near. Charging enhances potency.

The prophet despaired, looking up at the Erdtree, for soon the kindling would burst into flame, bringing ruin.
effect_details: Slam down on the ground do hit with Fire Attack Power equal to 183% of Incantation Scaling with a 3 meter radius and gain a Body Buff that hits 4/s with 45 Fire Attack Power with a 2 meter radius while ignoring Guarding. Lasts for 40 seconds and damages the caster for 6/s (240 damage total).

Charging the spell increases the Attack Power of the initial fire explosion to 212% of Incantation Scaling and the Body Buff's Attack Power per tick to 59. Self damage is increased to 8/s (320 damage total).

details: Left behind by the spirit of an artist located near the southern cliffs at the top of Dominula, Windmill Village, south of the Windmill Heights Site of Grace after acquiring "Flightless Bird" Painting.

notes: Costs 10 FP per cast.
Costs 28 Stamina per cast. Charging the spell increases Stamina cost to 36.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.
The initial fire explosion deals 7 Stance damage while the ticks from the Buff deals 0 Stance damage per hit. Charging the spell increases the Stance damage of the initial explosion to 10.
The self damage is technically 3/0.5 seconds for the uncharged version and 4/0.5 seconds for the charged version.
[Boosting]
Old Lord's Talisman increases the duration of this spell from 40 to 52 seconds.
Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.

→ Since charging the spell already increases Attack Power by 16% for the explosion and by 31% for the ticks, wearing this talisman increases the Attack Power by a total of 33% for the explosion and by 51% for the ticks.
[Strategies]
The Attack Power is too low to reliably defeat most enemies without additional sources of damage.
→ One notable exception are Skeletons, as they will remain at 1 HP after initially being defeated and will resurrect unless that last little bit of health is dealt with.

Fire attacks cleanse targets (and the user) of their Frostbite buildup, resetting the status effect. This spell synergizes particularly well with Frostbite builds by allowing them to trigger Frostbite damage more frequently than usual.

Both the initial cast and the Body Buff will trigger the one-time stun of Fingercreepers and the repeated stuns of Miranda Sprouts and Blossoms, but only the initial cast will trigger explosive barrels.

The constant HP drain from this spell can be mitigated by using the Blessing of the Erdtree or Blessing's Boon incantations, the Crimsonburst Crystal Tear; the Blessed Dew Talisman, the Icon Shield, or the Royal Remains Armor. Equipping the full Royal Remains Set will completely offset the damage at low HP.

notes: Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.

Excellent tracking before it begins to move, able to launch even at targets that have managed to get between the caster and the flame. The tracking remains fairly good after launching.

Has roughly 17% less Attack Power than Flame Sling with a similar casting time and the exact same FP cost. However, Flame Sling has no specific equipment that boosts only it, while Fire Serpent has several and stacking all of those means it will do roughly 1-3% more damage.
The range is fairly mediocre. This, in combinations with the strong tracking, makes this more of a short to medium range spell.
