items.effect: Increases physical damage negation
items.summary: Black Flame's Protection is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Godslayer Incantations.
items.description:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Summons black fire within, increasing physical damage negation. However, sacred flasks and other such forms of HP restoration are impaired.

The Apostles were all embraced by the Gloam-Eyed Queen, and the black flame was their armor within.
effect_details: Grants a Body Buff that decreases Physical damage taken by 35% (15% in PvP) while also decreasing all healing received by 20% for 70 seconds.

details: Acquired from Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after selecting the "about the secret medallion" dialogue option. This option will only appear after the player has obtained both the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) and Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).
Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 2,500 Runes should the player not talk to Gideon about both medallions before unleashing the Rune of Death.

notes: Costs 30 FP per cast.
Costs 13 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.

This spell reduces Physical damage taken rather than directly increasing damage negation. The total damage reduction can be expressed by the following formula, where PhysicalFortification represents the effect magnitude: TotalPhysicalReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - {PhysicalDamageNegation} \times 0.01) \times (1 - {PhysicalFortification}))

→ For example, if physical damage negation is 25 at the time of casting, the total reduction against PvE enemies would be 51.25%: PhysicalMagicReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.35)) = 51.25%
→ Against other players, the total reduction would be 36.25%: TotalPhysicalReduction = 100 (1 - (1 - 25 \times 0.01) \times (1 - 0.15)) = 36.25%
[Strategies]

The reduction in healing effective lowers the effectiveness of this spell to only lowering Physical damage taken by 18.75% (and increasing the effective damage taken in PvP by 6.25%), assuming that healing will be used and not accounting for it helping the player survive hits that otherwise would have killed them.

→ Effectively still has its full PvP strength of 15% in no-healing scenarios such as semi-formal duels in the open world or via a Duelist's Furled Finger, and the Duel Arena Combat mode available through the Royal Colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital or via Roundtable Hold.
The effectiveness of this spell diminishes as physical damage negation increases, offering less benefit when stacked with multiple physical negation sources.

This incantation is valuable whenever available since the vast majority of areas will have most of the damage inflicted by enemies as various types of Physical damage. The biggest exception is Liurnia of the Lakes, where Magic damage shares the spotlight.

Black Flame's Protection offers greater physical protection than Boiled Crab (35% vs. 20%) and has a slightly longer duration (70 vs. 60 seconds). This spell requires 30 Faith and 1 Memory Slot to be equipped and 30 FP to cast, while the Crab only requires 600 Runes per piece bought.
→ The Boiled Crab is preferable for PvP encounters, as Black Flame's Protection's effect is reduced to 15%.

→ Though Boiled Crab (and the slightly weaker Boiled Prawn) are potentially accessible much earlier, it's possible to not gain access to them should Blackguard Big Boggart be killed before any of either has been bought from him.

The reduction in healing for the Flask of Crimson Tears specifically can be countered with either the Crimson Seed Talisman or Crimson Seed Talisman +1, setting healing effectiveness to 96% and 104% respectively.
→ Note that this only helps with the flask, as the Heal spells are not affected by either talisman but is affected by the healing reduction.

notes: Costs 18 points of FP to cast.

Requires 1 Memory Slot.

The bloodflame effect actually inflicts 3 Blood Loss build-up per 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds.
[Boosting]
Damage is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon when charged.
→ Since the damage of the dagger slashes already are increased by 1% the total increase is 16% for them, while the final burst has its damage increase by 6% and thus gets a total increase of 22%.
[Strategies]
Since all of the Blood Loss comes from bloodflame effects the build-up doesn't scale with Arcane, even if the Dragon Communion Seal is used.

For context, most enemies have a default resistance to Blood Loss of roughly 400 to 500, meaning the uncharged spell's build-up of 180 will most likely cause the Status Effect in 3 casts and the charged version's build-up of 240 will usually cause it within 2-3 casts, provided that each cast is done somewhat quickly after the previous one.

The bloodflame effect actually inflicts 2 Blood Loss build-up per 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds.
[Boosting]
Old Lord's Talisman increases the duration by 30%, from 60 seconds to 78 seconds.
[Strategies]
The Blood Loss ticks from the bloodflame effect can stack if hitting the enemy multiple times.

→ This is because each Bloodflame effect occurs separately, unlike Blackflame effects, meaning that even if several hits by a weapon buffed with Bloodflame Blade happen within 2 seconds of the first the full 40 Blood Loss build-up per hit will still be applied.

→ Since the Bloodflame effect is always applied in full, i.e. it doesn't get scaled down on attacks with decreased effect for Status Effects or for Weapon Buffs, it combines well with multi-hit skills, such as Spinning Gravity Thrust, Repeating Thrust, Double Slash, Savage Claws, Charge Forth, and Blood Tax.

Pairs very well with weapons that have innate Blood Loss build-up as it effectively gives them another 40 Blood Loss build-up per hit.

items.name: Poison Mist
items.effect: Releases poison mist before caster
items.summary: Poison Mist is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Servants of Rot Incantations.
items.description:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Releases a poisonous mist before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
effect_details: Releases a short ranged cloud of poison with a 2.8 meter radius, inflicting 100 Poison build-up per second for 16 seconds (1,600 Poison build-up in total).

details: Dropped by a Scarab found north of the small, poisonous body of water east of the final stretch of road to Castle Morne.
→ More specifically, it's south of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace and northeast of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace, and east of the Map Weeping Peninsula.

notes: Costs 18 FP per cast.
Costs 10 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot.
Can move slowly while casting.
This incantation is silent when cast, and will not alert nearby enemies.
Technically inflicts 20 Poison build-up per 0.2 seconds.
The Poison build-up scales with the Arcane-scaling of the used seal.
[Boosting]

The 20 Poison build-up per tick inflicted by the spell can scale with Arcane if cast using the Dragon Communion Seal, up to 29 build-up per tick (145 build-up per second, or 2,320 build-up in total) with a +10 Seal at 99 Arcane.

→ With a +10 Seal: at 45 Arcane the build-up per tick will be 27 (135 build-up per second, or 2,160 build-up in total), and at 80 Arcane the build-up will be 29 (145 build-up per second, or 2,320 build-up in total).
[Strategies]
Since the spell is entirely silent it can (very slowly) kill enemies without alerting them.

→ The most notable example of this is the Draconic Tree Sentinel standing guard outside of Leyndell, Royal Capital, which will get poisoned every single silent cast and die in 8 of them (technically 7.25 casts).
→→ This entire process will take about 650 seconds, or just short of 11 minutes, due to the Sentinel having 8,398 HP on a default/NG Journey.
→ The qualifiers for what makes a good target is something that stands still and isn't immune to Poison.

→→ A target will need at most 16 poisonings/24 minutes to die due to the percentile damage (6.3% per full poisoning), though the flat damage (630 damage in total per full poisoning) means that the duration needed will probably be shorter.

[Boosting]
[Strategies]
The weapons that always scale the build-up with Arcane are the Ripple Blade Axe, Ripple Crescent Halberd, and Varré's Bouquet Hammer.

→ Assuming a maximum upgrade level, the Ripple Blade will increase the build-up to 116 at 20 Arcane and to 201 build-up at 80 Arcane, the Ripple Crescent Halberd will increase the build-up to 110 at 20 Arcane and to 182 build-up at 80 Arcane, and Varré's Bouquet's weaker scaling means it will increase the build-up to 107 at 24 Arcane and to 148 build-up at 80 Arcane.

The Bloodfiend's Arm Shadow of the Erdtree Colossal Weapon and Bloodfiend's Fork Shadow of the Erdtree Spear will also (weakly) scale the build-up with Arcane, but only on the Affinities that are freely buffable (Standard Affinity, Heavy Affinity, Keen Affinity, and Quality Affinity).

→ However, as these weapons have very weak Arcane-scaling they will only increase the build-up slightly: for the Arm it's increased to 92 build-up at 20 Arcane and 109 build-up at 45 Arcane with Standard Affinity and 78 build-up at 20 Arcane and 84 build-up at 45 Arcane with the other Affinities, and for the Fork it's increased to 85 build-up at 20 Arcane and 98 build-up at 45 Arcane with Standard Affinity and 83 build-up at 20 Arcane and 93 build-up at 45 Arcane with the other Affinities).

notes: Costs 16 FP per cast.
Costs 30 Stamina per cast.

Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.
Deals 5 Stance damage per hit. This increases to 9 Stance damage per hit if charged.

Attack Power is boosted by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.

The decent Stance damage and multi-hit potential makes it a great tool for breaking the Stance of enemies.
Madness does not effect PVE enemies unless said enemy is based on the Tarnished model, so it's often not very relevant there.

The flames have a wide spread and good range, making it hard for enemies to dodge; larger enemies such as dragons usually get hit by every flame.

→ While the flames usually hit the ground a short distance away from the caster, if the camera is unlocked it's possible to use this spell like a "shotgun" by aiming the camera at a steep downward angle.

Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

While screaming, all enemies within a 3.8 meter radius are hit up to 18 times with Standard Attack Power equal to 22% of Incantation Scaling and inflicted 35 Madness build-up per tick. The caster also takes 6 Madness build-up per tick (108 build-up in total). Afterwards, the caster is granted a Body Buff for 40 seconds where they deal 25% more damage but also take 30% more damage (50% more damage taken during cast of the spell) and draw enemy attention more than usual.

notes: Costs 21 FP per cast.
Costs 38 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.
Deals no Stance damage.
[Boosting]
The Roar Medallion increases the Attack Power of the AoE by 2%.
The Old Lord's Talisman extends the duration by 30%, from 40 seconds to 52 seconds.

[Strategies]

The Howl of Shabriri is best used as a Body Buff before the start of a big fight, albeit a risky one since it also lowers the caster's Damage Negation by 30%. However, this can be slightly mitigated by using Golden Vow, which grants the caster a 10% damage reduction.

→ One strong reason to use it regardless of the fact that it'll make the caster take more damage is that it's the strongest non-discriminate, offensive Body Buff, especially so for Lightning and Magic Attacks as they have no specific, offensive Body Buff.
→→ Ironically, Howl of Shabriri is arguably outclassed for Frenzied Flame Incantations by Flame, Grant Me Strength due to the latter's lack of a downside aside from a slightly shorter duration.
Madness does not effect PVE enemies unless said enemy is based on the Tarnished model, so it's often not very relevant there.

→ The Howl of Shabriri is quickest and the most cost-effective way to trigger madness on oneself. With low Focus, it usually only takes about two or three casts to self-inflict madness.
Very useful for killing invisible moving scarabs due to the attack-part of the skill lasting for roughly two seconds.

items.summary: Inescapable Frenzy is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Three Fingers Incantations.
items.description:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to blaze from the caster's eyes. The caster then latches onto foes, spreading the madness. This incantation also causes buildup of madness in the caster, and is only effective against Tarnished.

To gaze into one another's eyes is truly the most intimate form of human contact.
effect_details: The caster shrieks in pain as they grab their head and the flames of frenzy fill their eyes. Afterwards, the caster will then try to latch onto an enemy. If the grab is successful, the caster will stare deep into the enemy's eyes, hitting 8 times with Fire Attack Power equal to 180% of Faith-based Incantation Scaling and 50 Madness build-up. The grab does not work on enemies unless they are Tarnished. The caster takes 14 Madness build-up when the grab lands, and then takes 9 build-up for every tick of damage (72 build-up in total, or 86 with the initial tick from the grab).

While the grab itself will still do damage on non-Tarnished enemies, it will only be with Standard Attack Power equal to 70% of Incantation Scaling and 50 Madness build-up while the caster takes 14 Madness build-up, and the full effect of the incantation will not play out.

details: Inescapable Frenzy is found on top of a coffin near the bottom of the Frenzied Flame Proscription, which can be reached after defeating Mohg, the Omen.

notes: Costs 22 FP per cast.
Costs 31 Stamina per cast.
Requires 1 Memory Slot to be equipped.
Deals no Stance damage.
[Boosting]

The 50 Madness build-up per tick (400 build-up in total) inflicted by the spell can scale with Arcane if cast using the Dragon Communion Seal, up to 73 build-up per hit (584 build-up in total) with a +10 Seal at 99 Arcane.
→ With a +10 Seal: at 45 Arcane the build-up per tick will be 66 (528 build-up in total), and at 80 Arcane the build-up will be 71 per tick (568 build-up in total).
[Strategies]

Due to being a grab attack, the player will be left open if they miss. Using Skill: Endure before casting the incantation will ensure the player will be able to tank at least one hit from an enemy before getting knocked out of the animation; very useful for players will low poise.
Madness does not effect PVE enemies unless said enemy is based on the Tarnished model, so it's often not very relevant there.

Just like with most Three Finger Incantations, triggering madness either on yourself or on the enemy activates the Black Dumpling, the Madding Hand Shadow of the Erdtree, and Aged One's Exultation Shadow of the Erdtree.

→ Unlike the other Three Finger Incantations, triggering madness either on yourself or on the enemy with the grab part of Inescapable Frenzy does not activate the buffs of the Black Dumpling, the Madding Hand or Aged One's Exultation. This is because during the full grab animation, the player is rendered invulnerable, and exultation buffs are not coded to trigger if the player is in an invulnerable state.

→ However, the Frostbite build-up of the spell can even the field against non-immune enemies as it deals a significant amount of percentage-based damage and lowers their Damage Negation against further attacks.

items.name: Placidusax's Ruin
items.japanese_name: プラキドサクスの滅び (Purakidosakusu no Horobi)
items.effect: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax
items.summary:
Placidusax's Ruin is a spell in Elden Ring.

Though it may look similar, it's neither one of the Dragon Cult Incantations nor one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
Power gleaned from the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.

Transforms caster into the Dragonlord to spew golden breath from above. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

These are the dying wails of the Dragonlord who once dwelled eternally beyond time.
effect_details: Sends an electric burst almost immediately upon casting to deal Lightning damage and knock away players and lighter enemies, before sending out several sweeping, golden beams that deal Fire damage.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, dropped by Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

notes: This spell does not belong to any school of incantations, and as such doesn't have its damage boosted by any Sacred Seals.
The damage being split between Lightning and Fire damage makes it somewhat difficult to maximize the entirety of the spells through Crystal Tears and Talismans.
→ This damage split somewhat ironically gives it great similarity to the Incantations associated with Placidusax's archenemy Bayle the Dread, whose spells have the same split in damage types.
The initial burst of Lightning comes out very quickly and as such is surprisingly useful when fighting other players or player-type enemies such as NPC invaders.

infobox.obtained: Trade Enia a Remembrance of the Dragonlord

items.name: Dragonclaw
items.effect: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws
items.summary: Dragonclaw is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to tear through foes with dragon claws. Allows one follow-up attack.

Incantation of those who have hunted dragons and feasted upon their hearts. Theirs is a pure and overwhelming power.
effect_details: Lifts up and creates a massive dragon claw to slam down with Standard Attack Power equal to 395% of Incantation Scaling, and a 3 meter radius shockwave with Standard Attack Power equal to 253% of Incantation Scaling. Follow-up for a second slam, with a longer aftercast and increasing Attack Power to 410% of Incantation Scaling for the direct hit and to 263% of Incantation Scaling for the shockwave (along with increasing its radius to 4 meters).

details: Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion in the Realm of Shadow for 1 Dragon Heart.

notes: Costs 35 points of Stamina to cast.
Attack Power is increased by 15% when holding a Dragon Communion Seal in an active hand (32.25% if one is held in each hand).
Grants heavy Hyper Armor to resist attacks and also avoids some attacks that can be jumped over.

While casting it twice in a row with the same Sacred Seal will incur a long cooldown period after the second cast, alternating casts between Seals (one in each hand) will allow for a chain that can last as long as the user's FP lasts or until they are knocked out of the air (Stamina will almost fully recover between casts).
Pairs well with the Blue Dancer Charm due to the spell's Physical damage and the boosting Seal's 0 weight.

infobox.item_effect: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws

items.name: Dragonmaw
items.effect: Channels dragon to bite foes before caster
items.summary: Dragonmaw is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to bite enemies before them.

Incantation of those who have hunted dragons and feasted upon their hearts. Theirs is a pure and overwhelming power.
effect_details: The caster lifts up into the air and creates a large dragon head to bite down hard with Standard Attack Power equal to 628% of Incantation Scaling.

details: Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion in the Realm of Shadow for 1 Dragon Heart.

notes: Costs 50 points of Stamina to cast.
Attack Power is increased by 15% when holding a Dragon Communion Seal in an active hand (32.25% if one is held in each hand).
The spell actually has two separate hitboxes: the more damaging mouth and the weaker neck.
→ This incantation is surprisingly capable of, however rarely, landing headshots, increasing direct and Stance damage by 50%.

While extremely slow, taking around 4 seconds to cast, this spell deals heavy damage and has an excellent turning radius until the bite happens, making it a powerful and often worthwhile gamble if used correctly.
Deals a massive 55 Stance damage, more than even a fully charged heavy attack from hammer-type Colossal Weapons (which deals 45 Stance damage).
→ For context, most bosses have between 80 and 120 Stance (the greatest exception is Starscourge Radahn at a whopping 200 Stance).
Pairs well with the Blue Dancer Charm due to the spell's Physical damage and the boosting Seal's 0 weight.

items.name: Greyoll's Roar
items.japanese_name: グレイオールの咆哮 (Gureiōru no Hōkō)
items.effect: Emits the roar of Elder Dragon Greyoll
items.summary: Greyoll's Roar is an incantation spell in Elden Ring. It is one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.

Transforms caster into a dragon to emit a terrible roar, reducing the attack power and defense of nearby enemies.

Greyoll was the mother of all dragons, dwarfing all who stood before her like a looming mountain.
effect_details: Forms the roaring skull of Greyoll upon casting, hitting with Standard Attack Power equal to 320% of Incantation Scaling and inflicting knockback to Omen-sized and smaller enemies within a 7 meter radius, while also reducing the Damage Negation and Damage of all hit by 10% and 15% respectively for 60 seconds.

details: Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 3 Dragon Hearts after felling Elder Dragon Greyoll.

notes: Costs 72 points of Stamina to cast.
Damage can be boosted by 10% by the Roar Medallion and by 15% per Dragon Communion Seal held in an active hand (up to 2).

The debuff inflicted does not stack with any other defense or attack debuff, with the exception of Frostbite. This includes the two moon sorceries Rennala's Full Moon and Ranni's Dark Moon, the Shriek of Milos of the Sword of Milos, Acid Spraymist, and the Soul Stifler skill of the Winged Greathorn.
Deals 16.114 Stance damage, about on par with an uncharged heavy attack from Great Hammers.
Pairs well with the Blue Dancer Charm due to the spell's Physical damage and the boosting Seal's 0 weight.

items.name: Bayle's Tyranny
items.japanese_name: ベールの暴虐 (Bēru no Bōgyaku)
items.effect: Channels dread dragon to roar with a heatwave blast
items.summary: Bayle's Tyranny is an incantation spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

Channels the form of the dread dragon to emit a mighty roar accompanied by a heatwave burst, causing violent eruptions of fire in the area.

Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.
effect_details: Summons the head of Bayle to unleash a shockingly fiery roar, dealing Fire damage equal to 325% of Incantation Scaling and Lightning damage equal to 210% of the same, and creating patches of heat a short distance away from the caster that can hit up to 7 times for Fire damage equal to 50% of Incantation Scaling and Lightning damage equal to 20% of the same per hit.

details: Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
→ Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Flame Lightning, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.

notes: Damage is boosted by 15% per Dragon Communion Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Damage is boosted by 15% by the Talisman of the Dread.
Damage is boosted by 20% when the Rock Heart is used.
The initial explosion deals about two-thirds of its damage, and the remaining heatwave deals the remaining third in 7 ticks of damage.
Benefits from boosts to both Fire damage and Lightning damage, though more so the former than the latter.

items.name: Bayle's Flame Lightning
items.japanese_name: ベールの炎雷 (Bēru no Enrai)
items.effect: Channels dread dragon to strike with flame-lightning-infused talon bone
items.summary: Bayle's Flame Lightning is an incantation spell in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is one of the Dragon Communion Incantations.
items.description:
One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

Channels the form of the dread dragon in the right arm to smash foes with an exposed talon bone coursing with flame lightning.

Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.
effect_details: Summons one of Bayle's arms to slam down with, causing an explosion around the point of impact. A direct hit deals Standard damage equal to 250% of Incantation Scaling, Lightning damage equal to 280% of the same, and Fire damage equal to 220% of the same, while an enemy that isn't directly hit but moves into the point of impact afterward is dealt Lightning damage equal to 200% of Incantation Scaling and Fire damage equal to 150% of the same.
Enemies just outside of the hit area take Fire damage equal to 30% of Incantation Scaling and Lightning damage equal to 15% of the same.

details: Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
→ Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Tyranny, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.

notes: Damage is boosted by 15% per Dragon Communion Seal held in an active hand (2 max).
Damage is boosted by 20% when the Rock Heart is used.
Has some Hyperarmor when cast, and can thus resist a hit or two from most foes before being knocked down on the ground.
While it does partially do Lightning damage, it won't cause the same spreading aftershocks on water that other Lightning damage spells do.
